title: Conwy Castle
visualBrief: Present-day roofless Conwy Castle: eight open round towers, four tall inner-ward stair turrets, bent south hall range, paired open wards and low end barbicans.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X east, about 4.26 degrees north of east
nativeAxes.origin: Site anchor; Y0 standard PMTiles working datum.

identityFeatures: Eight round towers and four taller eastern stair turrets
Long western ward with faceted south great hall and surviving roof arch
Smaller eastern royal ward, roofless L-shaped rooms and low end barbicans

reconstruction.basis: Inspected reference pictures and standard viewer PMTiles.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Two overhead pictures confirm eight open round towers, paired roofless wards and the bent south hall. Standard viewer PMTiles and the cached exact castle outline set placement and east-west orientation. Court3.5m above the working sample clears the coarse rock surface; western town entry and eastern river barbican remain approximate. Anchor -3.82555084,53.280022417; heading 0.07442147105; standard PMTiles datum 8.781932169860132m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

limitations: Picture and standard PMTiles fit, not surveyed geometry or thresholds.
Detailed original Conwy geometry and recipe remain preserved. The independent derivative adjusts working datum and bounded foundation contact.
Eight open towers, four stair turrets, paired roofless wards and bent hall range provide identity. Openings, copings, wall scars, platforms and internal partitions remain approximate.
Coarse terrain does not resolve exact rock contact or approaches. No artificial hill, terrain cutout, navigable interiors, town walls or adjacent bridges are included.
Four common material graphs and local foliage tint; no embedded texture images. Physical-device timing and continuous-motion shimmer remain pending.
importReason: Preserve eight hollow towers, four raised stair turrets and open wards in all levels; surviving hall arches appear from district onward.
